page:
OpenAPI integration for automatic API documentation. Built around OpenAPI from ground up. Install plugin: `bun add @elysia/openapi`. Use plugin: .use(openapi()). Access documentation at /openapi - shows Scalar UI with generated documentation. Supports OpenAPI 3.0 specification with auto-completion. Unique feature: OpenAPI Type Gen infers schema directly from TypeScript types without manual annotation.
Questions: How do you enable OpenAPI? Where is documentation? What is Type Gen?

sections.manifest:
Detail field for API documentation following OpenAPI 3.0 spec. Example properties: summary (short operation description), description (verbose explanation), tags (route grouping), hide (hide from Swagger), deprecated. Provides auto-completion and type-safety by default.
Questions: What is detail field? What properties are available?

Reference model for reusable schema definitions. Define model: .model({ age: t.Object({ age: t.Number() }) }). Reference in route: body: 'age'. Shown in Components section of OpenAPI. Simplifies schema reuse.
Questions: How do you define models? How do you reference them?

OpenAPI Type Gen for automatic schema inference. Infers schema directly from TypeScript types without manual annotation. Unique to Elysia. Works with Drizzle ORM, Prisma queries. Apply fromTypes plugin before openapi: .use(openapi({ references: fromTypes() })). Browser environment limitation: requires fs module not available in web playground. Try locally with GitHub example.
Questions: What is Type Gen? How do you enable it? What is browser limitation?

Assignment: use preview to GET '/openapi' and see API documentation. Modify code to experiment and see documentation reflect changes.
